title: KMS/HSM lifecycle & secrets orchestration terraform module with telemetry and health probes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reusable Terraform module (private.kms_orbiter) that unifies KMS + HSM integrations with Secrets Manager and HashiCorp Vault for Redwood Private/VPC deployments. The module must: 1) provision and configure cloud KMS bindings (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) or wire into on-prem HSM via a PKCS#11 proxy; 2) provide a Terraform-managed secrets facade that supports dual-write migration between Secret Manager and Vault; 3) emit health probes (Terraform-managed endpoint definitions + config for a small k8s health operator) and drift-detection hooks; 4) produce telemetry events and metrics for rotation readiness, failed encrypt/decrypt, and key usage; and 5) include upgrade and rollback helpers (state transition plan for key rotations and canary policies). This ticket covers the module implementation, unit/integration test harness, basic docs and a staged rollout plan across dev->staging->prod private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module path exists at modules/private.kms_orbiter with examples for aws, azure, and hsm proxies
Module exposes inputs for kms_provider, vault_backend, dual_write_toggle, canary_policy, health_probe_config, telemetry_endpoint and rotation_policy
Health probe manifests and a k8s Job/Sidecar example are emitted and validated in integration tests
Integration tests run against SoftHSM (CI) and a real AWS KMS sandbox proving encrypt/decrypt and rotation workflow
Rollout doc with canary steps, expected telemetry signals, and rollback instructions published in Confluence
Security review completed and SSM/KMS permissions scoped to least privilege
tasks: scaffold terraform module and example overlays (aws, azure, hsm)
add dual-write primitives and an idempotent migration plan helper
implement health probes: liveness/readiness endpoints + k8s job for periodic encrypt/decrypt checks
hook telemetry: prometheus metrics and event log integration (console-telemetry endpoint)
build CI integration tests using softHSM and local Vault in GitHub Actions
write rollout and rollback runbook and add to private-deployments playbook
security review and IAM/KMS policy stubs
test_plan: Unit tests for all helper functions. Integration suite: 1) SoftHSM + local Vault - run terraform apply for hsm overlay, verify periodic health job succeeds; 2) AWS sandbox - deploy aws overlay, run an end-to-end encrypt/decrypt and rotation job; 3) Dual-write migration smoke test - enable dual_write_toggle, write secret, confirm both backends have same ciphertext metadata. CI must run SoftHSM tests on PRs and integration tests nightly against sandbox credentials.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge module with feature flag gated in module examples. 2) Deploy to dev private region with dual-write disabled and run health checks for 48h. 3) Enable canary_policy on a small subset of secrets (dev apps) for 72h and monitor telemetry. 4) Gradually expand to staging with dual-write enabled and run migration helper. 5) Full prod rollout only after telemetry signals show no error spikes and security review signed off. Use automated rollback step in step 3 if encrypt/decrypt error rate > 0.5% over 1h.
rollback_plan: If a regression is observed during canary: 1) Disable canary_policy (terraform apply) to prevent new material changes; 2) Revert module to previous released tag via module source pinning; 3) If key rotation caused failures, use the module's rotation-reverse helper to revert to previous key version for affected aliases; 4) Notify SRE and run targeted decrypt replays to verify fix.
decisions: Support both cloud KMS and PKCS11-backed HSM via an adapter interface rather than separate modules to reduce duplication
Dual-write migration is implemented as an opt-in toggle to reduce blast radius
Health check will be a lightweight k8s Job + prometheus metric instead of continuous agent to minimize permissions
tradeoffs: Unified provider abstraction increases module complexity but reduces customer config surface
Dual-write provides safer migrations but requires careful reconciliation tooling; initial version will be best-effort with reconciliation runbook
Telemetry/metrics add signal but will require additional IAM permissions to export key operation counts
notes: Avoid storing plaintext secrets in Terraform state; module will create data resources that do not output plaintext and will recommend using remote backend with state encryption
For on-prem HSMs, recommend configuring an authenticated PKCS11 gateway running in the customer VPC; we will provide a reference helm chart for that gateway
Rotation policy will be driven by schedule input; default is rotation every 365d with canary window of 7d
